t:6fb46162b8669cd3.title: Actual protected death and wandering preserve counter reservation across every Worker restart and replay
t:6fb46162b8669cd3.bindingNote: Actual Lancelot dedicated counter and ordinary CHOOSE_RECLAIM followed by protected Lia death: reservation stays outside deck/hand until parent completion and returns once to the same living owner after wandering. This does not prove exit or a second same-name use.
